messages:
sam: heads up — found plaintext STAGING_DB_URL in partner-analytics logs (s3://partner-logs/2026/03/20/ingest.log). looks like a full pg uri with user:pass. :rotating_light:
security-bot: alert generated (detector: creds-in-logs). incident id INC-5241 created and assigned to #eng-security. automated scan found 2 files.
maria: thx. treat as P1. @devon @lee can you triage scope+blast radius?
sam: pasted the redacted snippet here: `postgres://svc_ingest:REDACTED@staging-db.redwood.internal:5432/ingest` — log time 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z. removed original file from partner bucket and flagged owner.
devon: ok plan: 1) revoke current db creds 2) provision new creds in Vault (KMS-wrapped) 3) update partner ingest to use new wrapped secret 4) rotate any consumer SAs that used the username. need short maintenance window to swap.
lee: RBAC change: will lock down vault path `secret/data/ingest/staging` to only `ingest-runner` role. will add explicit deny for legacy `svc_ingest` sa and create policy for ephemeral access. also recommend enabling MFA for any human accounts that can read that path.
oncall: infra pinged, can do a 5-10min window at 17:40 PT. will patch canary first and confirm healthy before wide roll.
devon: quick commands for the rotation (copy/paste):
```bash
# write new secret to KV (Vault v2)
vault kv put secret/ingest/staging DB_URL='postgres://svc_ingest:NEWP@ssw0rd@staging-db:5432/ingest'
# encrypt for partner's remote storage (KMS)
echo -n 'postgres://svc_ingest:NEWP@ssw0rd@...' | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=redwood-prod --key=partner-ingest --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | base64 > wrapped.txt
```
maria: note: partner store expects base64 wrapped ciphertext; we'll push wrapped.txt to their secure endpoint. also we need to rewrap any old ciphertexts after KMS key rotate.
sam: I also ran a grep across recent ingest logs and found 2 other files with similar URIs. uploaded evidence to the incident doc and redacted copies to /secure/incidents/INC-5241/.
lee: enable Vault audit on the ingest path before rotation so we capture reads/writes during swap. example: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit-ingest.json` and set retention/forwarder to our secure-bucket.
maria: I'm going to run the rotation script now in staging, then prod after canary passes. script (short):
```bash
# rotate script (local testing)
set -e
NEW_URL="postgres://svc_ingest:$(openssl rand -base64 12)@staging-db:5432/ingest"
vault kv put secret/ingest/staging DB_URL="$NEW_URL"
# bump version and notify partner
./scripts/wrap-and-upload-to-partner.sh "$NEW_URL"
```
oncall: canary patched, health ok at 17:46 PT. ready for prod swap on your go.
maria: doing prod swap in 2m. I'll post a final roster: rotated secrets, revoked tokens, RBAC changes, and rewrap summary. tagging compliance@redwood for retention and audit. :white_check_mark:
security-bot: INC-5241 updated: status=mitigating, assignees=[maria, devon, lee], artifacts=/secure/incidents/INC-5241/, severity=high.
sam: thanks all — after rotation I'll pull a post-sweep grep for a week window and confirm no further exposures. if anyone sees residual artifacts ping me.
